description: Reconciled sign maps for L1 (SSPLL Type-I), L2 (SSPLL Type-II PM60), L3 (CPPLL impulse PMct60), f_ref 4 GHz, |T| -3 dB 320 MHz, 8-phase PMUX + input DTC, first-order accumulator, ideal injection model e = (a-w_g) rho + sum (eps_k-w_k) 1{p=k}, alpha = j/4096 exact (floor convention). kappa_phos = min Re eig(C_PHOS on observable subspace)/open-loop reference (=8 Re lambda for 8|Q); kappa_gos_acnorm = C_GOS/var(rho) (=12 C_GOS for long periods); kappa_joint = joint 9x9 min Re eig / PHOS reference.  'inverted' = kappa < -tau, 'dead' = |kappa| <= tau.  Intervals in MHz of min(alpha,1-alpha)*f_ref.  large_signal_A_inf: kappa_inf = <sign(h*d_v) z_v>/|<sign(d_v) x_v>| worst over directions {gos, PHOS DFT modes 1c,1s,2c,3c,4} (A >> sigma_v limit of the 1-bit comparator).
